parcel_delivery_check.name: parcel_delivery_check
parcel_delivery_check.value: ("parcel"."status" = 'remis') = ("parcel"."delivered_at" is not null and "parcel"."delivered_by" is not null)

parcel_pieces_check.name: parcel_pieces_check
parcel_pieces_check.value: "parcel"."piece_total" is null or ("parcel"."piece_total" >= 1 and ("parcel"."piece_n" is null or "parcel"."piece_n" between 1 and "parcel"."piece_total"))
